description: This file contains functions and types for interacting with Zalo via a custom SDK, including login, messaging, reactions, group management, and QR code login handling.

classes.name: ActiveZaloQrLogin
classes.description: Represents an active QR login session with associated state and control functions.

classes.name: ActiveZaloListener
classes.description: Represents an active listener for Zalo messages with a stop function.

classes.name: AccountInfoResponse
classes.description: Type alias for the awaited result of API.fetchAccountInfo.

classes.name: ApiTypingCapability
classes.description: Interface for API methods related to typing indicators.

classes.name: StoredZaloCredentials
classes.description: Structure for storing Zalo session credentials locally.

methods.name: resolveStateDir
methods.description: Resolves the directory for plugin state storage based on environment variables.

methods.name: resolveCredentialsDir
methods.description: Resolves the directory path for storing credentials.

methods.name: credentialsFilename
methods.description: Generates filename for credentials based on profile name.

methods.name: resolveCredentialsPath
methods.description: Resolves full path to credentials file for a given profile.

methods.name: withTimeout
methods.description: Wraps a promise with a timeout, rejecting if the timeout is exceeded.

methods.name: delay
methods.description: Returns a promise that resolves after a specified delay.

methods.name: normalizeProfile
methods.description: Normalizes profile string, defaulting to 'default'.

methods.name: toErrorMessage
methods.description: Converts an unknown error to a string message.

methods.name: clampTextStyles
methods.description: Clamps text styles to fit within the message content length.

methods.name: toNumberId
methods.description: Converts a value to a string ID, handling numbers and strings.

methods.name: toStringValue
methods.description: Converts a value to a trimmed string.

methods.name: normalizeAccountInfoUser
methods.description: Extracts User object from account info response.

methods.name: toInteger
methods.description: Converts a value to an integer with fallback.

methods.name: normalizeMessageContent
methods.description: Normalizes message content from various formats.

methods.name: resolveInboundTimestamp
methods.description: Resolves timestamp from raw data, converting to milliseconds.

methods.name: extractMentionIds
methods.description: Extracts mention IDs from mention data.

methods.name: toNonNegativeInteger
methods.description: Converts a value to a non-negative integer or null.

methods.name: extractOwnMentionSpans
methods.description: Extracts and merges mention spans for the own user.

methods.name: stripOwnMentionsForCommandBody
methods.description: Removes own user mentions from command message content.

methods.name: stripLeadingAtMentionForCommand
methods.description: Removes leading @ mention from message content.

methods.name: resolveGroupNameFromMessageData
methods.description: Resolves group name from message data fields.

methods.name: buildEventMessage
methods.description: Builds a Zalo event message object from raw data.

methods.name: extractSendMessageId
methods.description: Extracts message ID from send message response.

methods.name: resolveMediaFileName
methods.description: Determines filename for media based on URL and content type.

methods.name: resolveUploadedVoiceAsset
methods.description: Finds uploaded voice asset URL and filename.

methods.name: buildZaloVoicePlaybackUrl
methods.description: Builds playback URL for voice message.

methods.name: mapFriend
methods.description: Maps User object to ZcaFriend.

methods.name: mapGroup
methods.description: Maps group info to ZaloGroup.

methods.name: readCredentials
methods.description: Reads stored credentials from file.

methods.name: touchCredentials
methods.description: Updates last used timestamp in stored credentials.

methods.name: writeCredentials
methods.description: Writes credentials to file.

methods.name: clearCredentials
methods.description: Deletes stored credentials file.

methods.name: ensureApi
methods.description: Ensures an API session is active for a profile, restoring from stored credentials.

methods.name: invalidateApi
methods.description: Invalidates and stops the API session for a profile.

methods.name: isQrLoginFresh
methods.description: Checks if a QR login session is still fresh based on timestamp.

methods.name: resetQrLogin
methods.description: Resets (aborts and deletes) a QR login session.

methods.name: fetchGroupsByIds
methods.description: Fetches group info for a list of group IDs in chunks.

methods.name: makeGroupContextCacheKey
methods.description: Creates cache key for group context cache.

methods.name: readCachedGroupContext
methods.description: Reads cached group context if valid.

methods.name: trimGroupContextCache
methods.description: Removes expired or excess entries from group context cache.

methods.name: writeCachedGroupContext
methods.description: Stores group context in cache with expiration.

methods.name: clearCachedGroupContext
methods.description: Clears cached group contexts for a profile.

methods.name: extractGroupMembersFromInfo
methods.description: Extracts member display names from group info.

methods.name: toInboundMessage
methods.description: Converts raw message to normalized inbound message.

methods.name: zalouserSessionExists
methods.description: Checks if a Zalo session exists for a profile.

methods.name: checkZaloAuthenticated
methods.description: Checks if Zalo session is authenticated and active.

methods.name: getZaloUserInfo
methods.description: Retrieves user info for a profile.

methods.name: listZaloFriends
methods.description: Lists all friends for a profile.

methods.name: listZaloFriendsMatching
methods.description: Lists friends matching a query.

methods.name: listZaloGroups
methods.description: Lists all groups for a profile.

methods.name: listZaloGroupsMatching
methods.description: Lists groups matching a query.

methods.name: listZaloGroupMembers
methods.description: Lists members of a group.

methods.name: resolveZaloGroupContext
methods.description: Resolves and caches group context.

methods.name: sendZaloTextMessage
methods.description: Sends a text message to a thread.

methods.name: sendZaloTypingEvent
methods.description: Sends typing indicator to a thread.

methods.name: resolveOwnUserId
methods.description: Resolves the current user's ID.

methods.name: sendZaloReaction
methods.description: Sends a reaction to a message.

methods.name: sendZaloDeliveredEvent
methods.description: Sends a delivery/read receipt event.

methods.name: sendZaloSeenEvent
methods.description: Sends a 'seen' event.

methods.name: sendZaloLink
methods.description: Sends a link message.

methods.name: startZaloQrLogin
methods.description: Initiates a QR code login process.

methods.name: waitForZaloQrLogin
methods.description: Waits for QR login to complete.

methods.name: logoutZaloProfile
methods.description: Logs out and clears session for a profile.

methods.name: startZaloListener
methods.description: Starts a message listener for a profile.

methods.name: resolveZaloGroupsByEntries
methods.description: Resolves group IDs from a list of group names.

methods.name: resolveZaloAllowFromEntries
methods.description: Resolves user IDs from a list of user display names.

methods.name: clearProfileRuntimeArtifacts
methods.description: Clears runtime artifacts for a profile.
